site_surface.short_summary: Temur Frontier is a VM-208 live-pilot Tarkir wedge packet for Green-centered GUR survival, instinct, mental fortitude, shamanic listening, elemental memory, and harsh-terrain endurance.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Temur asks what strength becomes when survival depends on instinct, listening, memory, and the living world answering back.
site_surface.tagline: Listen to the wild. Endure the cold. Strike with earned strength.
best_for: readers drawn to survival, instinct, shamanic listening, and earned strength
players who like dragons, ramp, copying, elemental energy, and huge force as support-only Commander texture
reviewers checking that Temur stays separate from generic GUR, Atarka Clan continuity, Commander products, Dragonstorm backfill, seed files, and raw runtime readiness
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Temur material can involve harsh survival, scarcity, raids for supplies, cultural intrusion, hunger under Atarka, and guarded isolation. This packet keeps thin card, biography, Commander, and detailed modern governance topics deferred.

core_identity.summary: Temur Frontier is the Green-centered GUR Tarkir wedge expression whose source-bound floor is savagery, inner strength, mental fortitude, instinct, Qal Sisma survival, shamanic listening, elemental memory, and careful timeline separation from Atarka and modern Dragonstorm material.
core_identity.philosophy: Green centers physical survival, acceptance, harmony with the natural world, growth, and strength. Blue carries knowledge, mental strength, problem solving, transformation, and disciplined perception. Red carries freedom, action, impulse, emotion, directness, and force in conflict.
core_identity.central_tension: Vox Mana synthesis models Temur's tension as listening versus isolation, instinct versus wisdom, survival versus suspicion, and preservation versus adaptation.
core_identity.interpretive_note: Central-tension and metaphysical compression are Vox Mana synthesis from normalized TEMUR evidence plus VM-204/VM-205 shaping docs. They are not official Wizards or MTG canon.

semantic_model.identity_floor: Official design presents Temur as Green-centered Green-Blue-Red savagery; official Tarkir lore supplies the era-specific culture, roles, whisperers, and modern Endless Song context.
semantic_model.interpretive_lens: Vox Mana interpretation: Survival Through Attunement reads Temur lore and color tension together as listening before decisive action. It is an optional Commander archetype, not a universal Temur rule.

exploration_archetypes.title: Large Creatures / Ferocious
exploration_archetypes.copy: Start with substantial creatures and the Khans-era Ferocious anchor, then choose the Commander support that makes those threats matter.

exploration_archetypes.title: Ramp / Big Mana
exploration_archetypes.copy: Use Green-Blue-Red resource growth to support expensive spells, activated abilities, or larger threats; this is a Commander direction, not Tarkir lore.

exploration_archetypes.title: Spells / Copying
exploration_archetypes.copy: Build around interaction, spells, or copied effects when the commander gives those tools a clear job; this is a broader Commander expression, not Temur Frontier culture.
